faqItems.q: What is a Sinhala voice transcriber?
faqItems.a: A Sinhala voice transcriber converts spoken Sinhala audio into written Sinhala text. HelaVoice is an AI-powered Sinhala voice transcriber built for Sri Lankan creators, students, journalists, and businesses — it accepts recordings or audio files and returns an accurate transcript in seconds.

faqItems.q: How do I convert Sinhala voice to text?
faqItems.a: To convert Sinhala voice to text, sign in to HelaVoice, then record your voice directly in the browser or upload an audio file. The AI transcribes your Sinhala voice to text in seconds, and you can copy, edit, or download the transcript. It's the fastest way to turn Sinhala voice notes, meetings, and interviews into accurate text.

faqItems.q: How do I transcribe Sinhala audio to text?
faqItems.a: Sign up for a free HelaVoice account, then either record audio directly in your browser or upload an existing audio file (MP3, WAV, WebM, OGG, FLAC, or M4A). HelaVoice processes the audio in 60-second chunks and returns the Sinhala transcript, which you can copy, edit, or download.

faqItems.q: How accurate is HelaVoice for Sinhala speech-to-text?
faqItems.a: HelaVoice is purpose-built for Sinhala speech-to-text and handles the nuances of Sinhala pronunciation and Sri Lankan dialects. Accuracy is highest when the audio is clear and free of heavy background noise; quiet single-speaker recordings typically transcribe with very high fidelity.

In Sinhala, "transcribe" is commonly translated as "පරිවර්තනය කිරීම" or "ලිවීම" — converting spoken words into written text. HelaVoice is the Sinhala voice transcriber that does this automatically using AI.

faqItems.q: Can I transcribe Sinhala audio messages (WhatsApp or voice notes)?
faqItems.a: Yes. Save the audio message from WhatsApp or your messaging app, then upload it to HelaVoice. Common voice-note formats (M4A, OGG, MP3) are supported up to 25MB per file. HelaVoice is well suited as an audio message transcription service for Sinhala language voice notes.

HelaVoice is simple: 1 minute of audio uses 1 credit. New accounts get 10 free credits on signup with no credit card required. Credit packages start small and never expire — you only pay for the credits you use.

faqItems.q: What audio formats and file sizes are supported?
faqItems.a: HelaVoice accepts MP3, WAV, WebM, OGG, FLAC, and M4A files, up to 25MB per upload. You can also record directly in your browser without installing anything.

faqItems.q: How do I generate Sinhala subtitles for a video?
faqItems.a: Sign in to HelaVoice, open Video Subtitles, and upload your video (MP4, WebM, or MOV). The AI transcribes the audio into timed Sinhala subtitle segments in minutes. You can then edit the text, adjust timings on a timeline, style the subtitles, and export an SRT/VTT file or an MP4 with the subtitles burned in.

faqItems.q: Is my video uploaded to your servers?
faqItems.a: No. Your video never leaves your device — HelaVoice extracts the audio track in your browser and only sends short audio chunks for transcription. Subtitle export and video rendering also happen entirely on your device.

faqItems.q: What subtitle formats can I export?
faqItems.a: You can export standard SRT and WebVTT subtitle files, which work with YouTube, VLC, CapCut, Premiere Pro, and most video editors. You can also export an MP4 copy of your video with the styled subtitles burned in — for free.

Subtitle generation costs 2 credits per minute of video, using the same credit balance as transcription. Editing, styling, translation previews, and all exports are free. New accounts get free credits on signup.

faqItems.q: Can I translate Sinhala subtitles to English?
faqItems.a: Yes. After generating subtitles, one click translates the whole subtitle track between Sinhala and English while keeping all the timings — billed at the standard translation rate of 1 credit per 1,000 characters.
